criteria.title: Backend emits progress ack only after route and auth pass
criteria.assertion: Authorized, routed ContextVM requests publish an encrypted notifications/progress JSON-RPC notification before handler dispatch; routing mismatch remains silent and unauthorized requests do not emit an ack.

criteria.title: System discovery advertises v2 progress ack capability
criteria.assertion: Discovery control_plane.capabilities includes encrypted_controlplane.progress_ack and control_plane.wire_version is contextvm-jsonrpc-v2.

criteria.title: Frontend progress parser is ack-only
criteria.assertion: notifications/progress notifications with no id/result/error clear the short ack timer but never resolve/reject the terminal request result.

criteria.title: Two-phase timeout is capability gated
criteria.assertion: The short ack timeout applies only when the v2 progress ack capability is advertised; legacy discovery keeps the single long timeout.

criteria.title: Frontend publish preconditions fail fast
criteria.assertion: Encrypted request paths reject before publish when encrypted requests are unavailable, service pubkey is invalid/missing, or no Bahia relay is connected.

criteria.title: Service secrets unavailable state is non-alarming
criteria.assertion: Service detail secrets hydration shows a friendly unavailable/control-plane-unreachable state and logs at info/debug level rather than warning.
